custom_preconds:
Staging org (custom-role browser login is unsupported on local).
Custom role A: Settings > App Settings ON (to reach /administration) + Settings > Integrations ON.
Custom role B: Settings > Finance ON + Settings > Integrations OFF.
Both roles provisioned via API with a confirmed user each.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as role A and open /administration.

custom_steps_separated.expected: The Integrations group header and the IBS sidebar item (link_ibs_tab) are visible.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as role B (settingsFinance, no settingsIntegrations) and open /administration.
custom_steps_separated.expected: Administration renders and Payment Methods (link_payment_methods_tab) is visible.

custom_steps_separated.content: Observe the left-nav for the Integrations group.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Integrations group / IBS item (link_ibs_tab) is ABSENT.

title: Integrations admin section is gated on settingsIntegrations, independent of settingsFinance
